exposure: Offspring gut microbiota (Eubacterium_xylanophilum_group, Ruminococcus_gauvreauii_group, UCG-002, Gemella, Veillonella)
cohort: A total of 36 maternal-offspring pairs from central China were enrolled and followed up to 2 years postpartum.
finding: The study found that specific differences in maternal and offspring gut microbiota compositions at various time points (pregnancy, birth, 6 months, 1 year, 2 years) were associated with the subsequent development of pediatric atopic dermatitis.
